_comment: The word lists of the viewer's limn/plain-names ESLint rule (eslint.config.mjs, tools/viewer_naming.mjs; docs/handbook/viewer.md §이름과 주석). A declared name is split into words (camelCase, PascalCase, UPPER_SNAKE, digits) and every word must be a whole word: at least 3 letters, or listed in `english` or `allow`. A word in `deny` is refused whatever its length,; a plural is its own entry (`msgs`). `loopIndex` names pass only as the whole name declared in a for loop's head. Adding an entry is a reviewed change: an `allow` entry carries its reason, a `deny` entry the whole word to write instead. Every word is lowercase.

allow.db: database - the IndexedDB handle and its name
allow.i18n: internationalization - the numeronym every i18n library and file uses
allow.id: identifier - the field name the server API and the DOM both use
allow.io: input/output, and the IntersectionObserver the lazy-drawing code names io
allow.ms: milliseconds - the unit of every delay and timestamp
allow.px: CSS pixels - the unit of every length
allow.ui: user interface - the viewer's own word for its screen
